stations.title: Kofi
stations.say: The laptop still had me signed in!

stations.title: The API
stations.text: No sign-out, and sessions never end.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: No way to end a session

captions: Kofi found the studio laptop still signed in as him the morning after an evening class.
Today a session never ends, and there is no way to sign out of one.
You add a real sign-out, an eight-hour end for each session, and a check for it.
Now Kofi signs out and his token is worthless, even where someone copied it.
Every session ends: when its owner signs out, or eight hours after it began.
